name: joke-chatbot-prototype
description: Researcher-controlled workplace joke reaction experiment prototype.

scripts.check: node --check site/js/core.js && node --check site/js/app.js && node --check site/js/evaluator.js && node --check site/js/remote-api.js && node --check site/js/remote-app.js && node --check worker/src/experiment.js && node --check worker/src/index.js
scripts.worker:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.worker:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run worker:prepare:deploy && npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.deploy.toml && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.deploy.toml
